main_body: large timber-framed house with tiled hipped and gabled roof
top_band: tiled roof slopes in warm orange, yellow, brown, and purple-brown tones spanning rows 0 to 42 on the main wings and down to row 56/74 on the central gable
evidence: The building clearly shows a large foreshortened top roof surface (rows 0-42 across the main wings, extending to row 56 at the central gable peak) above the vertical timber-framed south walls (rows 43-74 on side wings, 56-106 on the central projection). style.evidence: The candidate is an authentic Beodeul chipset building using the exact same tilework, plaster speckle, wood grain, and 6-step material shading ramps as the reference houses on the left.
